findings.title: Verify 字源 scan finding for 767E
findings.details: [SCAN VERIFICATION REQUIRED] 字源 (2012), PDF p. 303 / printed p. 291, 百 entry: the occurrences rendered in the OCR as glyph placeholders [g033], [g034], and [g035], under “百字在殷商时代并不统一，指事符号下作…”, are visible in the inspected scan but their exact Unicode identities are not established. Preserve the occurrence-bound shapes; do not substitute guessed characters. The scan directly supports the surrounding prose and printed page number.
findings.verification: Check the identified printed page and exact scan span; correct source-bound OCR or record an unresolved glyph identity.
